name: SaveMyPower
title: Save My Power
author: LiroxDeYamon
description: Preserves power when picking up accumulators. Supports modded accumulators and quality. Highly customizable. Contact @liroxdeyamon on Discord (Scatterverse or Factorio) or make a discussion/issue on factorio mod portal/github if you want help with localization or report a bug. Special thanks to Quezler for providing their code template. Special thanks to RedRafe for allowing to use part of their code and partial help with Solar Productivity compatibility.
